title: The Defect Is in the Arithmetic Between the Files: Static Detection of Exactly-Once Violations in Payment Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.31298v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether a streaming payment pipeline charges a customer twice after a restart turns on a comparison nobody performs: how long the provider remembers an idempotency key, against how stale a record can be when the pipeline processes it for the second time. The first number is in the provider's documentation. The second is not written anywhere. It is assembled from a checkpoint interval in one file, a recovery assumption in a runbook, a restart delay in a third and a source's lateness bound in a fourth. Each file is defensible alone; the fault is in the relation between them. We give a checker that gathers those facts and states the relations, and a synthesiser that turns 335 of the 515 findings into a runnable scenario: these records, kill the job here, bring it back after this long, and this is the observable. 245 of them produce two charges. translated_title: 缺陷在于文件之间的算术关系：支付流水线中“恰好一次”语义违反的静态检测
translated_abstract: 流式支付流水线在重启后是否会向客户重复扣款，取决于一个几乎无人进行的比较：提供方记住幂等键的时长，与流水线第二次处理某条记录时该记录可能过期的程度。第一个数字写在提供方的文档中；第二个数字则没有写在任何地方——它由分散在各处的信息拼凑而成：一个文件中的检查点间隔、一份运行手册中的恢复假设、第三个文件中的重启延迟，以及第四个文件中数据源的迟到上界。每个文件单独来看都无懈可击，缺陷恰恰在于它们之间的关系。本文提供了一个检查器来收集这些事实并陈述其间的关系，还提供了一个综合器，将515个发现中的335个转化为可运行的场景：给定这些记录、在此处终止作业、等待这么长时间后重启，即可观察到相应结果。其中245个场景会产生两次扣款。核心度量是证据之间的距离有多远。在630条流水线的语料库中，我们……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种静态检测方法，通过收集分散在不同文件中的幂等键保留时长与记录最大过期时间等参数并分析其数值关系，检测支付流水线重启后可能违反“恰好一次”语义的隐患，并将515个发现中的335个转化为可运行的故障复现场景，其中245个场景被证实会导致客户被重复扣款。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a static detection method that identifies exactly-once violations in payment pipelines by gathering parameters scattered across multiple files—such as idempotency key retention time versus maximum record staleness—and analyzing their arithmetic relations, converting 335 of 515 findings into runnable fault-reproduction scenarios, 245 of which demonstrably produce double charges.
